name: govmod
description: Modular governance for multi-option staked disputes: players stake on the options of a question (two or many), then a token-weighted vote OR an M-of-N multisig picks the winning option whose backers split the pot pro-rata. Every player agrees to the same token, threshold (quorum), min-stake, and time limit before the case goes live; BlocTime blocks are the default clock. Verdict mechanism, voting token, and privacy are pluggable. Sealed (commit-reveal) voting keeps individual votes private — only aggregate stats show until the case resolves — with zk-friendly nullifiers and a pluggable eligibility-proof hook. Gas-minimal: agreement and votes are off-chain; settlement posts a single Merkle root that winners claim (O(1) gas each).
